Write code that compares metric values for two resources or dimension filters over the same window using a concrete provider.

REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Amazon CloudWatch Metrics
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_metric_data, get_metric_statistics, list_metrics
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION

  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/metrics/custom_metrics/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/

Option 6 — Azure Monitor Metrics:
  Service: Azure Monitor Metrics

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: query_resource, list_metric_namespaces, list_metric_definitions
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-platform-metrics, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/monitor-querymetrics-readme

```python
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3

def compare_metrics(
    project_id: str,
    metric_type_1: str,
    filter_1: str,
    metric_type_2: str,
    filter_2: str,
    hours: int = 1,
    aggregation: str = "MEAN"
):
    """
    Compare metric values for two resources/dimension filters over the same window using Google Cloud Monitoring.

    Args:
        project_id: Google Cloud project ID
        metric_type_1: First metric type (e.g., "compute.googleapis.com/instance/cpu/utilization")
        filter_1: First filter expression (e.g., 'resource.instance_id = "instance-1"')
        metric_type_2: Second metric type (e.g., "compute.googleapis.com/instance/cpu/utilization")
        filter_2: Second filter expression (e.g., 'resource.instance_id = "instance-2"')
        hours: Time window in hours (default: 1)
        aggregation: Aggregation type (MEAN, SUM, COUNT, etc.)

    Returns:
        dict: Comparison results with values for both metrics
    """
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    project_name = f"projects/{project_id}"

    end_time = datetime.utcnow()
    start_time = end_time - timedelta(hours=hours)

    # Common interval for both queries
    interval = monitoring_v3.TimeInterval({
        "end_time": {"seconds": int(end_time.timestamp())},
        "start_time": {"seconds": int(start_time.timestamp())}
    })

    # Query first metric
    query_1 = monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_name,
        filter=f'metric.type="{metric_type_1}" AND {filter_1}',
        interval=interval,
        view=monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
        aggregation={
            "alignment_period": {"seconds": 60},
            "per_series_aligner": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MEAN
            if aggregation == "MEAN"
            else getattr(monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner, f"ALIGN_{aggregation}")
        }
    )
    series_1 = list(client.list_time_series(request=query_1))

    # Query second metric
    query_2 = monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_name,
        filter=f'metric.type="{metric_type_2}" AND {filter_2}',
        interval=interval,
        view=monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
        aggregation={
            "alignment_period": {"seconds": 60},
            "per_series_aligner": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MEAN
            if aggregation == "MEAN"
            else getattr(monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner, f"ALIGN_{aggregation}")
        }
    )
    series_2 = list(client.list_time_series(request=query_2))

    # Extract values
    value_1 = series_1[0].points[0].value.double_value if series_1 else None
    value_2 = series_2[0].points[0].value.double_value if series_2 else None

    return {
        "metric_1": {
            "type": metric_type_1,
            "filter": filter_1,
            "value": value_1,
            "unit": series_1[0].metric.unit if series_1 else None
        },
        "metric_2": {
            "type": metric_type_2,
            "filter": filter_2,
            "value": value_2,
            "unit": series_2[0].metric.unit if series_2 else None
        },
        "time_window": {
            "start": start_time.isoformat(),
            "end": end_time.isoformat()
        }
    }
```
